parsed.rationale_overall: System B more explicitly ties recommendations to specific profile attributes (variable income, $4M target, legacy goal, debt level, age) and provides more concrete execution details with specific ticker allocations and dollar amounts. System A is slightly more disciplined on factual grounding and avoids some of B's looser claims, but B's broader diversification awareness (US concentration, cyclical sector concentration, crypto-vs-liquidity) and stronger actionability give it the edge.
